d: Triangle shaped hovering objects were seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained. The sightings occurred in a more than two year "wave" over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.

In the early 90’s, teenagers Adam and Gwen tell their story of red lights dancing in the sky, Julie recalls a terrifying drive home as she is chased by a UFO, experts offer theories of what they may have seen.

Tony tells of his close encounter as a 17 year old, now 60 years on the subject has become an obsession. Experienced pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying his plane.

st: The Skull That Changed Science, The Bat Bomb and The Stone Age Mulitool
d: In a display case at Harvard University’s Warren Anatomical Museum is one of the most astonishing objects in medical science – the shattered skull of a 19th century American railway worker.

st: The Stone Ball, The Electrocution and The Cat Mummy That Wasn't
d: In 1860, workmen digging a drainage ditch in a Scottish hamlet discover the Towie Ball, a strange and beautiful black stone object about three inches in diameter. It has been painstakingly carved into a bulbous shape from a single block of rock.
At a mysterious site in the Gobi Desert, experts discover a monster graveyard - a groundbreaking find containing treasures of alien beasts.
Cold War spy satellite photographs of mysterious structures hidden in Poland's forest motivate local archaeologist Grzegorz Kiarszys to hunt them down.

Over the past 50 years a fascinating pattern has emerged, linking UFOs with military personnel and installations. One of the most significant of these events took place on British soil in 1980. This programme contains some flashing images.

The US government officially recognise UFOs, calling them Unidentified Aerial Phenomena. In this episode Craig and Sarah take on the US Navy UAP videos. They speak to an ex-MOD official, Nick Pope. This programme contains some flashing images.
While many UFO sightings occur in rural locations with only a single eyewitness, there have been sightings over cities witnessed by hundreds.
With science closer than ever to proving that life once lived on Mars, is there a chance that something still exists there.
Chile, Puerto Rico, and Japan are some of the locations in the world that receive more UAP sightings than anywhere else. What are the causes behind these so-called “hotspots”.

The Alien Disclosure Files is a series that delves into these current and historical unexplained incidents and brings together leading experts in the fields of ufology and the paranormal to try to uncover the truth.

d: This metal sphere is just seven hundredths of an inch across, no bigger than the head of a pin. Yet under extreme magnification it shows two holes that have been precision drilled through it. Each one is just four times the width of a human hair.
